en.title: Weekend capacity is repeatedly reached
en.summary: Four consecutive weekends show peak-hour entries at capacity.
en.notes: This supports unmet demand but does not prove every added hour will be used.
assumptions: The counting method is consistent across weekends.

zh.title: 周末容量反复达到上限
zh.summary: 连续四个周末的高峰时段入馆人数均达到容量上限。
zh.notes: 这支持未满足需求的判断，但不能证明每个新增时段都会被使用。
assumptions: 各周末采用一致的统计方法。
